overview.about: The Abu Dhabi Grand Prix has closed the Formula 1 season since 2009, a day-to-night race under floodlights around the Yas Marina Circuit. Its marina, hotel and grandstands make it one of the sport's showcase venues, and as the finale it has repeatedly settled the world championship - most dramatically in 2021. Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton share the win record with five each. The 2026 race is on 4-6 December.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix runs 4-6 December at Yas Marina, the traditional season finale. The twilight start means the race begins in daylight and finishes under lights, and a recent layout change added faster, flowing corners to improve overtaking.

@graph.description: Yas Marina opened Formula 1’s Abu Dhabi Grand Prix in 2009, and the event has become the championship’s regular season finale. The circuit sits on Yas Island, where the track combines a permanent facility with the marina-side setting that gives the race its distinctive visual identity. The existing OneSliders page records the current edition’s dates directly in its Event JSON-LD. Race-weekend planning depends on the official organiser’s session timetable and entry instructions; the event data therefore preserves the page’s stated calendar rather than inferring a different date or venue. The Abu Dhabi round is a Formula One World Championship race, with practice, qualifying and the Grand Prix forming the core on-track programme.
